name: Business Research Starter
description: A safe example RoyalOS plugin that adds an Atlas-powered business research workflow without modifying RoyalOS source files.
author: RoyalOS Example

actions.label: Research business topic
actions.description: Ask Atlas to investigate a business topic and return a structured executive report.
actions.promptTemplate: Research the following business topic for the selected company. Return an executive summary, evidence, opportunities, risks, competitors, and recommended next actions. Topic: {{input}}
